Engineering is actively engaged and assessing the issue. We will provide updates accordingly.
We are continuing to investigate this issue.
We are continuing to investigate this issue.

This has been resolved and Frontend Observability is operating normally in this region. We are continuing to investigate and monitor the remaining impacted services.
We are seeing errors in Frontend o11y again. We are continuing to investigate and monitor the impacted services.
This incident has been resolved.
